issues.issue: These amounts equal the growth of the Water CD (10,000.00 to 10,447.03) and the Sewer CD (15,000.00 to 15,670.54) on p1/p3, so the line is almost certainly CD interest (Interest Income). The printed label is 'Other', so 'other' can be defended.
The form keeps 'Public Works - Other' separate from 'Public Works - Streets', so streets/highways is an assumption. The function is not stated.
